exposure: Infants grouped based on presence/absence of risk factors: cesarean delivery, low birth weight, and premature birth
outcome: Motor development at three months of age, assessed using Bayley-III Scale of Infant and Toddler Development (BSID-III) and Alberta Infant Motor Scale (AIMS)
cohort: 756 mothers and their three-month-old babies in Southern Brazil
finding: Babies born by cesarean delivery, prematurely, and with low birth weight had lower motor development scores at three months of age.
mod_finding: Babies born by cesarean delivery had lower motor development scores when assessed by the BSID-III.
